purpose: Different industry labels with the same preserved functional structure must generate the same governing discovery signatures.

testimony.content: Once the beds are ready, the field lead takes over the planting work.
If the request is above the normal spend limit, the owner has to approve it.
If planting fails inspection, the field lead fixes it and it is checked again before the bed is released.

observations.description: Responsibility moves to an execution bearer after a readiness condition.
Approval authority changes at a threshold.
A failed state has an authorized repair and restored-state verification.

testimony.content: Once the environment is ready, the implementation lead takes over the deployment work.
If the request is above the normal spend limit, the owner has to approve it.
If deployment fails validation, the implementation lead fixes it and it is checked again before release.
